title: 第一三五三章 你也就如此罢了第一三五二 第六步
content_zh:
狄九对放九重一抱拳，“多谢放道友了。”
不是放九重，绝对不会这么快找到姜千王。
“太爷，我已经是第五步了。”闪电激动不已的冲上来叫道。
狄九早就看见闪电是第五步了，他一挥手，两道大道道则分别渗透进丁小叮和闪电的紫府中，只是片刻狄九就哼了一声。
看见狄九动作的放九重微微一笑，“是不是丁小叮和闪电都被烙了印记？”
狄九点点头，“是的，不过现在我随时可以将这印记剥开。”
“看样子姜千王和虚暮伦是知道我们来了，走吧，他们应该也是在等着我们。”放九重说道。
狄九感受到道树中那一道隐晦的道韵印记微微一动，他立即就知道这是姜千王在查看他的所在。仅仅是一下，狄九就知道了姜千王的位置。
“走吧，我们过去，如果新宇宙有任何不妥，我不会杀这两个人的。”狄九的语气平静，却带着一种毋庸置疑的态度。
有的时候，不杀比杀更可怕。狄九如果选择不杀的话，他会让姜千王后悔修道。
混沌飞星速度极快，仅仅是一个时辰，就在混沌之中停了下来。
“好大的手笔啊。”姜千王看见混沌飞星，感叹一声，心里是暗自钦佩狄九的好运气。竟然连这么大的浩瀚铁晶也能找到，还将这浩瀚铁晶炼制成了混沌飞星。
他姜千王去过多少宇宙?在混沌之中经历了多少时间？可他也从未见过如此大的一块浩瀚铁晶啊。
“原来我的浩瀚铁晶和炼道金都是你拿的。”虚暮伦盯着狄九脚下犹如星球一般大小的浩瀚铁晶，语气冰寒，带着一种极致的杀意。
这种杀意语气在混沌之中，自动形成了一道传送规则，落在了众人的耳边。
就连姜千王也诧异的看着虚暮伦，一直以来，虚暮伦都是一副平和冷静的态度，从未如现在这样，语气带着杀意，脸色都有些狰狞了。
“是你放的？”狄九惊讶的看着虚暮伦，这家伙可真有些气魄啊。将炼道金和混沌飞星放着，任凭其成长。可惜的是，炼道金刚刚成长起来，就被自己拿来了。
“没错，是我放的，我倒是要感谢你帮我将东西送来。”说这句话的时候，虚暮伦已经是恢复了冷静，语气也变得极为平缓起来。
狄九淡淡一笑，没有再废话。
虚暮伦却继续说道，“浩瀚铁晶应该是你从别的地方得到的吧？炼道金才是你从我放置的地方抢走的。”

狄九根本就没有问虚暮伦浩瀚铁晶是如何流出去的，平淡无波的说道，“浩瀚混沌，不知道有多庞大和宽广。如果随意一个地方都可以变成自己的，呵呵，那整个浩瀚混沌都是我的，你同意不？”
虚暮伦没有理睬狄九，一边的姜千王却淡淡说道，“原来我还以为这一方如此规则的宇宙是谁构建的，原来是你啊。只是让我疑惑的是，你是如何构建出这一方宇宙的。”
姜千王的确是疑惑，他感受到了新宇宙中的浩瀚规则大道，也感受到了万物大道和归一大道。
就算是狄九三道兼修，也无法借助混沌创造出这样的一个宇宙出来，这不是能力的问题，而是道的问题。除非有三个人，同时在混沌之中构建同一个宇宙，而且这三人互相要完全的信任对方，不能有半点心机，这才勉强有机会构建出这样一个顶级的规则宇宙。
但姜千王认为这是不可能的，先不要说这三个人有多难找。因为这三个人每一个人的大道都是最顶级的大道，这样的人找一个也艰难无比了，何况三个？其次是这三个人就算是你找到了，姜千王也绝不相信这样的三个惊才绝艳的强者，会完全的信任对方，敞开自己的大道运转，允许对方查看自己的大道道则。
要知道对任何一个修道者而言，自身
大道才是极致秘密，比性命还重要的秘密。
狄九此刻已经感应到了新宇宙，新宇宙仅仅是被各种大道束缚住，还没有被破开，这让狄九松了口气。
content_en:
Di Jiu hugged Fang Jiuzhong and said, "Thank you so much, fellow Taoist Fang."
Had it not been for Jiuzhong, he would never have found King Jiang Qian so quickly.
"Master, I'm already on the fifth step." Lightning rushed up and shouted excitedly.
Di Jiu had long seen that Lightning was on the fifth step. He waved his hand, and two great paths penetrated into Ding Xiaoding's and Lightning's Zi Mansion respectively. In just a moment, Di Jiu snorted.
Fang Jiuzhong smiled slightly when he saw Di Jiu's movements, "Have Ding Xiaoding and Lightning been branded?"
Di Jiu nodded, "Yes, but now I can peel off this mark at any time."
"It seems that King Jiang Qian and Xu Mulun know that we are coming. Let's go, they should be waiting for us." Fang Jiuzhong said.
Di Jiu felt the faint Tao Yun mark in the Tao tree move slightly, and he immediately knew that this was where King Jiang Qian was checking his location. In just one moment, Di Jiu knew the location of King Jiang Qian.
"Let's go. If anything goes wrong in the new universe, I won't kill these two people." Di Jiu's tone was calm, but with an unquestionable attitude.
Sometimes, not killing is scarier than killing. If Di Jiu chooses not to kill, he will make King Jiang Qian regret practicing Taoism.
The Chaos Flying Star was extremely fast, and it stopped in the chaos within just an hour.
"What a great gesture." King Jiang Qian sighed when he saw the Chaos Flying Star, secretly admiring Di Jiu's good luck. Unexpectedly, he was able to find such a large vast iron crystal, and refined this vast iron crystal into a Chaos Flying Star.
How many universes has Jiang Qianwang been to? How much time has he experienced in chaos? But he has never seen such a huge piece of vast iron crystal.
"It turns out that you took my vast iron crystal and alchemy gold." Xu Mulun stared at the vast iron crystal that was as big as a planet at Di Jiu's feet, his tone was cold, with an ultimate murderous intent.
This murderous tone automatically formed a transmission rule in the chaos and fell on everyone's ears.
Even King Jiang Qian looked at Xu Mulun in surprise. Xu Mulun had always had a calm and calm attitude, but he had never been like this before. His tone was murderous, and his face was a little ferocious.
"Did you release it?" Di Jiu looked at Xu Mulun in surprise. This guy is really brave. Leave the Alchemy and Chaos Flying Stars and let them grow. It's a pity that Alchemy was taken away by me as soon as it grew up.
"Yes, I put it there. I would like to thank you for helping me deliver the things." When he said this, Xu Mulun had already regained his composure and his tone became extremely calm.
Di Jiu smiled lightly and stopped talking nonsense.
Xu Mulun continued, "You should have gotten the vast iron crystal from somewhere else, right? It was you who took the Alchemy Gold from where I placed it."
Di Jiu didn't even ask Xu Mulun how the vast iron crystals flowed out, and said calmly, "The vast chaos, I don't know how huge and wide it is. If you can make any place your own, haha, then the entire vast chaos is mine, do you agree?"
Xu Mulun ignored Di Jiu, but Jiang Qianwang on the side said calmly, "So I thought who built this universe with such regular rules, it turned out to be you. What makes me confused is how you built this universe."
King Jiang Qian was indeed confused. He felt the vast avenue of rules in the new universe, and also felt the avenue of all things and the avenue of unification.
Even if Di Jiu practiced both Taoism and Taoism, he would not be able to create such a universe with the help of chaos. This is not a problem of ability, but a problem of Tao. Unless there are three people building the same universe in chaos at the same time, and these three people must completely trust each other and not have any scheming, then there is barely a chance to build such a top-level rules universe.
But Jiang Qianwang thought this was impossible, so he didn’t want toTalk about how hard it is to find these three people. Because each of these three people has a top-notch path, it is extremely difficult to find one such person, let alone three? Secondly, even if you find these three people, King Jiang Qian will never believe that these three amazingly talented people will completely trust each other, open their own avenues to operate, and allow the other party to check their own avenues.
You must know that for any ascetic, oneself
The great road is the ultimate secret, a secret more important than life.
Di Jiu has sensed the new universe at this moment. The new universe is only bound by various avenues and has not been broken. This makes Di Jiu breathe a sigh of relief.
